model: exact density matrix of the touched qubits of each compiled circuit: depolarizing PRX and CZ, ASAP idle T1/T2, herald-conditioned readout; no coherent error, leakage or crosstalk

star.rule: rank every star of four usable qubits (a center and three neighbors on calibrated couplers) by fewest qubits with a non-linear retained parallel PRX train, then fewest qubits the train did not measure, then the largest product of the three CZ fidelities, then the largest PRX RB fidelity of the weakest qubit, then the names; the first row is the patch
